name: Convergence F / L / E / Li
primary:
A projectile flies in an arc where you look and strikes the first target. Effects:
• Damage 1.25 ❤ fire + 1.25 ❤ lightning + 1.25 ❤ earth (lightning ×2 on wet, fire ×0.5 on wet, earth ×2 on frozen)
• Heat: sets on fire for 6 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Charge 35: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 4 targets in a row, jumps up to 4 blocks, 1.25 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
• Light push
• Breaks up to 3 blocks within 0.5 blocks (twice as many if brittle)
• Heals 1 ❤
• Regeneration: +0.5 ❤ every 2 s for 6 s
• Growth: up to 2 nearby blocks — crops +2 stages, dirt turns to grass, roots grow upward
• Rooted in place for 3 s
self_description:
On you:
• Damage 1.25 ❤ fire + 1.25 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet, fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 6 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Charge 35: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Stone skin (Resistance I) for 7 s
• Slowness I for 5.5 s
• Heals 1 ❤
• Regeneration: +0.5 ❤ every 2 s for 6 s
